description: This file defines an enum ChargePaymentMode used in the FinEmploye acr in the Apache Fineract project to represent different modes of charge payment, specifically 'REGULAR' and 'ACCOUNT_TRANSFER'. It includes methods for retrieving mode values, codes, converting from integers, and checking if the mode is account transfer.

classes.name: ChargePaymentMode
classes.description: An enum representing different charge payment modes in the Fineract system.

methods.name: ChargePaymentMode
methods.description: Constructor for the enum instances, initializing value and code.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the payment mode.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the payment mode.

methods.name: validValues
methods.description: Returns an array of valid integer values for the payment modes.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to the corresponding ChargePaymentMode enum instance.

methods.name: isPaymentModeAccountTransfer
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is ACCOUNT_TRANSFER.
